page.layout: One printed page, title page: a woodcut ornamental band at the top, a central oval woodcut emblem with a ring of lettering, and below it the imprint in centred lines and a rule followed by the date.
page.notes: Woodcut ornamental band at the head of the page, without text. Central oval woodcut emblem with a palm frond and a hand/scroll motif; the lettering around the oval ring is only partly legible (fragments such as "ALMA DEI" and "MISERIC" appear) and is not transcribed, as it cannot be read with certainty. Below the imprint, a rule separates the date. The date line reads as printed "M D C XII." with the final numeral written as XII and a trailing stop; the stop after "Schonfeldianâ" is present. Faint stains and show-through at the top edge and a blue-stamped rectangle at the lower centre (a library stamp) are not transcribed. The page number is not printed.
